per_finding.note: The triage never mentions the control system bug or excessive device interactions as the root cause.
R-001's action to verify mechanical cooling is still running and its 'small portion' signal directly point at the cooling shutdown in part of the datacenter.
PLC controller failure and its role in blocking purge mode are not mentioned anywhere in the triage.
The triage lists control-system failover and lost visibility only in not_covered, so it is not directed by any matched rule or action.
R-001 directs verifying cooling and transferring to generators, but not the manual reset of equipment into maximum cooling configuration.
Disabling the failover mode that triggered the bug is not stated or implied by the triage.
Training local operations teams to identify and remediate the situation is not part of the triage.
Modifying air handling unit control so purge mode bypasses PLCs is not mentioned in the triage.
R-002 warns hardware can be damaged before shutdown, pointing toward the hardware failures and instance retirements.
